description: Next-day measured-soil proxy screening with temporal and unseen-station holdouts; no fabricated irrigation labels

issues.title: Obtain farm irrigation and root-zone ground truth
issues.body: The current target is a measured shallow-moisture threshold proxy. Acquire independently licensed farm/root-zone measurements and observed irrigation decisions before claiming an irrigation recommendation or water savings.

issues.title: Quantify seasonal missingness and correlated-day uncertainty
issues.body: Evaluate missing/frozen-soil periods and estimate interval uncertainty with time-block resampling without tuning the already inspected test.
